listing.description: Free speech-to-text plugin for Astra. Uses Google Web Speech API with no API key required. Supports 38 languages. Install and speak.
config.language.label: Language
config.api_key.label: Google API key (optional)
config.api_key.description: Your own Google API key for www.google.com/speech-api. Leave empty to use the built-in free chromium key.
config.max_audio_secs.label: Max phrase length (seconds)
config.max_audio_secs.description: Truncate audio longer than this before sending. Google rejects requests over ~60 seconds. 0 = no limit.
config.timeout_secs.label: Network timeout (seconds)
config.timeout_secs.description: How long to wait for Google to answer before the request fails. 0 = default 10 s.
config.silence_timeout_ms.label: Silence to end phrase (ms)
config.silence_timeout_ms.description: End the phrase and send it after this much quiet, instead of waiting for Astra's own silence detection. 0 = use Astra's setting.
